messages:
alyssa-cs: Kicking off QuantumCorp private deployment readiness thread. Customer is targeting a pilot go-live next Tue and asked for network diagram + IAM mapping by EOD Friday.

sanjay-netops: Quick checklist for networking: VPC peering, route tables, SG rules, NAT/IGW, endpoints (S3, KMS), NACLs, and check for CIDR overlaps. Example customer CIDR: `10.12.0.0/16`.

mike-sol: I'll draft the IAM role mapping: `redwood-quantum-serve`, `redwood-quantum-deploy`. Need the customer AWS account ID and KMS key ARN to finish trust policy. @alyssa can you confirm account id?

alyssa-cs: Yep — account id is 987654321000 (shared in the customer portal).

jess-sec: Audit logs ask: push CloudTrail + inference access logs to their S3 with MFA delete and object lock. We need to validate KMS CMK policy for cross-account decrypt/encrypt and confirm retention (they asked 7 years).

sanjay-netops: I'll produce a Terraform starter for peering + endpoints. Snippet:```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "rdw_qcorp" {
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-0abc1234def"
  auto_accept = false
}
```

mike-sol: For least-privilege cross-account access, recommend STS AssumeRole with external ID. Example trust principal: `arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/QuantumRedwoodOps`. Will add session tagging to limit scope.

alyssa-cs: Note — CMK rotation/rotation window was flagged as an audit dependency. If we can't meet their rotation policy or key-usage proof, this becomes a renewal risk. Marking medium risk until KMS and network validations complete.

jess-sec: I'll run a quick gap analysis vs our SOC2 checklist. Need sample CloudTrail config, S3 bucket policy, and a KMS key policy from the templates. Can someone drop links to those assets?

mike-sol: Uploaded IAM + KMS templates to the shared drive (placeholder): https://drive.redwood.com/qcorp-templates. Also adding an assume-role test script.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to dedicated staging for QuantumCorp on 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC. Will post canary metrics to this thread once complete.

sanjay-netops: I'll own the connectivity playbook (PDF + Terraform modules) by Friday EOD. Owning test plan for ICMP, traceroute, and a perf baseline for 1k concurrent inference connections. Tagging @mike-sol to coordinate IAM test runs.

alyssa-cs: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll send the customer a consolidated timeline and invite them to a 30-min sync on Monday. Action items: sanjay (connectivity checklist + playbook), mike (IAM role + assume-role tests), jess (audit/gap analysis), infra-bot (canary notice).

mike-sol: :eyes: Will prepare assume-role examples and a small script to validate AWS KMS decrypt for cross-account. Example: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/QuantumRedwoodOps --role-session-name qcorp-test`.

alyssa-cs: Closing loop for now — will update this thread after Monday sync. If anything blocks, ping here. :wave:
